articles.title: This may be the ‘missing piece’ for investors looking to boost AI exposure
articles.summary: Investors looking to boost their exposure to artificial intelligence should target China, according to Matthews Asia portfolio manager Andrew Mattock. He said investors will need a more deliberate approach because broad emerging market strategies won't be that effective. "The big piece that you are missing… is the Chinese piece." articles.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
articles.summary: Investors were rattled this week as the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield soared to its highest level since 2007, but sticky inflation is just one of the factors behind this latest surge. The 10-year yield's rapid climb above 5% shows how quickly investors' expectations have shifted toward additional tightening from the Federal Reserve in light of stubborn inflation. "I think this year it has more to do with the bond issuance than the inflation story," he told CNBC.
